propositions: rebar-implement subagent in Phase 4d lacks explicit model tier specification, causing it to inherit the orchestrator's expensive model tier instead of running on a cheaper tier
skill documentation needs capability-tier guidance to distinguish which implementation work is safe for cheaper models versus which requires escalation to strong tier
held-out-TDD invariant (test-authoring and validation on strong tier, separate implementer on cheaper tier) must be preserved while enabling model tiering
Phase 3 non-code-leaf dispatch, Phase 4a existing-coverage search, and Phase 4d implementation dispatch require explicit tier annotations and escalation rules
model tiering must be framed as capability levels with cross-harness portable examples (Claude Code and Codex CLI mappings) rather than hardcoded model names to ensure forward compatibility
